  • ffmpeg:

       (includes ffprobe)
    2. Extract the zip to a folder, e.g. C:\ffmpeg
    3. Add the bin folder (e.g. C:\ffmpeg\bin) to your PATH environment variable
    4. Open a new terminal and run "ffmpeg -version" to verify
